Happy New Year everyone! The following fixes have been implemented:

Congratulations to [b]TAMANEGI [/b]for having the single player high score all week, and to

notes.title: Demo Release
notes.notes:
🔹 [b]Think Fast-[/b] Launch tetrominos into a nuclear core.

🔹 [b]Use the X-Ray Drop-[/b] Create massive chains while balancing your core to avoid a meltdown.

🔹 [b]Reaktor Vibes-[/b] Become a Nuclear Control Engineer, and take control of a Soviet-era reactor.

🔹 [b]Multiplayer-[/b] Demo supports up to four friends!


[b]If you're a fan of classic tetromino games and want a new challenge, play the free Reaktor demo NOW![/b]
